metadata.title: Fictional Football Player Database
metadata.description: 600 fully fictional football players with nationality-appropriate names and game-ready FIFA/PES-inspired attributes. No real player identities are intended.
metadata.position_rating_method: Outfield position ratings compare the player's six main attributes using position-specific weights, then apply a small familiarity bonus. The primary position is anchored to the listed overall. Goalkeepers use a separate goalkeeper attribute set.
notes: All players, clubs, and player attributes are fictional and intended for game development.
Outfield players use FIFA-style six main attributes and detailed sub-attributes.
Goalkeepers use a dedicated goalkeeper stat set; they do not receive outfield stats.
Position ratings are calculated from the player's attribute profile and can be higher or lower than the primary-position overall.
Each player has exactly one tactical role and between 2 and 5 skills.
Dynamic game_state values are starting defaults and can be modified by the game engine.
